# Load libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(hexbin)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

```

# Setting up a dataset 

```{r}

MYCN <- read.delim("data/zcc_MYCN_exp.tsv") 
colnames(MYCN)[7:8] <- paste("MYCN_",colnames(MYCN)[7:8], sep = "")

ALK  <- read.delim("data/zcc_ALK_exp.tsv") 
colnames(ALK)[7:8] <- paste("ALK_",colnames(ALK)[7:8], sep = "")

MYCN_ALK <- inner_join(MYCN, ALK %>% dplyr::select(X,ALK_zscore,ALK_TPM.Values))

```

# Example plots 

```{r}
#boxplot
ggplot(MYCN_ALK, aes(x = log2(MYCN_TPM.Values), y = category))+ geom_boxplot() + theme_bw()

#correlations
ggplot(MYCN_ALK, aes(x = log2(MYCN_TPM.Values), y = log2(ALK_TPM.Values))) + geom_point() + theme_bw()

#facet
ggplot(MYCN_ALK, aes(log2(MYCN_TPM.Values), log2(ALK_TPM.Values))) + geom_hex() + facet_wrap(~category) + theme_bw()

```
